title: A Dynamical Fekete-Szegő Theorem
summary: Let $E\subset\Bbb{C}$ be a compact set symmetric with respect to the real axis. A classical theorem of Fekete-Szegő asserts that such a compact set is of logarithmic capacity at least one if and only if it admits approximation by algebraic integers whose Galois conjugates lie arbitrarily close to $E$. In this note we prove a dynamical analogue of this phenomenon.
